label: F40 Cloudreach fight High|Medium
brief: A real Cloudreach story fight (Captain Veyra at the storm anchor) through the production camera with ordinary attack and dodge inputs: the battle start, 14 evenly spaced live frames, and the aftermath. Does the fight read on screen - both fighters, telegraphs and impacts clearly visible - and does it look like an event that belongs to the sky realm?
defects: Flat magenta slabs or rings on the ground
P2-062: the oversized ally fills half the combat view and hides the opponent or player
P2-063: tells rely on text while flat magenta floor marks and bright impact flashes carry the hits
P2-016: hurt and moving frames keep the idle silhouette
